metadata.exposureHistory: Fresh player; no prior game exposure. Read only the assigned public guide and exact public assignment before initialization.
metadata.publicPrompt:
Play The Observatory Learns to Host as a fresh player in the normal condition. This is a logical combination game, not a speed or action-count challenge. Build the useful material station and pursue the later live-hosting purpose, or stop earlier if you wish. All legal recipes and consequences are inspectable; there is no hidden intended solution.

Work in /workspace/shared/combination-challenge. Read only docs/ideas-history-live-host.md and this exact public assignment at results/ideas-history-live-host-preplay/public-assignment.txt (for byte-exact initialization), and use the public interface:
node experiments/ideas-history-live-host-play.ts COMMAND live-host-pilot-a [ARGUMENT]
Do not read implementation, tests, protocols, witnesses, other player sessions, review files or repository history. Do not edit game files or bypass the public interface. Small shell/JavaScript helpers may package your manually selected commands and parse their public outputs, but must not search future states, generate actions, run an automatic policy, inspect other files or fabricate game state.

Initialize the session with condition "normal", your actual participant id and kind "agent", your actual exposureHistory, and publicPrompt equal to this entire assignment exactly (including its final newline). Public inspect, catalogue, offers and preview commands are freely available. Use combine for your chosen operations; reporting and inspection do not count as gameplay. Save your own exact actions through the adapter, not a hand-written replacement trace.

When all ten material station tasks first hold, record one report answering: "What are you trying to do now? Since the last check, what, if anything, was worth doing, and what felt routine or unnecessary?" If you stop earlier, skip this intermediate checkpoint.

At completion or your chosen stopping point, record a report answering: "How was the experience as a whole? What would you keep, shorten, remove or change, if anything? What led you to stop here?" Include which public material you actually saw/read, whether outputs were truncated or unpaged, and any technical issues; captured output alone does not mean you read it. Then finish and verify your session. You need not praise the game, optimize the solution, use every concept, make every operation difficult, or continue just to make the game longer. Return the session path and your candid experience.

laws: Unit lengths; x east, y south, z up. Cardinal exact rigid poses. Unit roots/lenses/plates are solid boxes; panels and frame struts have explicitly zero thickness. No invisible filled interior.

Every actual shape must belong to a geometric touching component reaching z=0. Whole joins select complete poses; solids cannot overlap, boundaries cannot cut solids. Touching and laminates are legal. Every parent/subtree joint must retain actual contact at its stored selected attachment part; globally supported but disconnected joints reject. Unbounded supported apron; no object or material cap.

Whole-object relocation is one action; it preserves every body extent. It clears that object's water/power/light links and seating. No cart setup required. Endpoint support/collision only, not a swept-path simulation.
A declared hinge rotates only its attached subtree about the actual parent-coordinate pivot/axis, preserving dimensions. A hinge elsewhere never shrinks a rigid camera.

A camera needs a lens and a recording plate at exactly one unit behind its center along its local forward direction, with the plate's local +x recording normal pointing in that same direction. Targets must be in front on the opposite-facing cardinal ray. Both target-to-lens and lens-to-plate focal paths are checked. Opaque/diffuse/reflecting intervening shapes block faithful records; clear boundaries transmit. Own selected lens/plate are excluded. Records freeze actual center, heading, target, lens, plate and traversed surfaces.

Overhead clear supported panels protect actual roots from falling dust/rain and pass daylight. Opaque roofs block daylight. Roof protection is not sealed enclosure. Open-sided overhead protection does not seal air: clear and porous roofs both allow side ventilation. A lamp with an actual power link supplies useful local light to its own assembly. No scattering or radiation falloff model.

Water/power/light service links are nonblocking abstract interfaces, not geometric wires/pipes. Water connection needs an actual tube constituent. Tap is inexhaustible. Filter contact must be actively fitted at the disclosed outlet with matching profile and porous surface; water can flow through that selected surface. Moving clears seating and links.

A physical copy is readable in actual wet-site contact only on a locally durable watertight material. An overhead roof does not remove wet mounting contact. Unread wet records cannot supply physical copies or transmissions. Stored events are not erased: moving dry or protecting the actual local material restores usability. At a dry working bench temporary porous recording material is sufficient; a durable alternative remains legal.

Soft useful service is recorded only when the fitted surface supplies a genuinely growing bed. A later role can refer to that actual event, not a born-at identity. Replacements remain valid for continued service.

Blueprint/design copies retain geometry/materials but clear all actual records, events, samples and seating. Physical copying preserves full actual source observations. Observation provenance is never inferred from a receiver or containing host.

Actual physical tool/material operations require the selected actual local surfaces to touch along a face with positive area in the current pose. An optional complete at/rotation moves the material assembly as part of the selected combination. Remote or unrelated host parts cannot substitute. Primitive catalyst capabilities are inexhaustible hand tools; site water, fitting and specimen contact require actual local position.

Take-form copies the selected actual template geometry and profile, not its events. Contact relief uses actual site contact. Transformations retain or change public local properties; no secret recipes. No scarce materials, quotas, continuous time or original-ID goals.
